title: County agency to pay nearly $13 million to run gas pipeline to Micron site in Clay
summary: The Onondaga County Industrial Development Agency is committing nearly $13 million to extend natural gas pipeline infrastructure to the Micron Technology semiconductor manufacturing facility under construction in Clay. This capital investment supports regional economic development and industrial site readiness for a major technology employer.

political_signal.description: County-level investment in infrastructure to support Micron facility development; signals priority alignment with regional economic development and industrial attraction strategy

processing_notes: Article sourced from syracuse.com (external news); County IDA is state agency partner, not direct City department
Geographic scope: Clay (town outside Syracuse proper, but regional economic impact)
Infrastructure type: natural gas pipeline (utility infrastructure)
Intergovernmental collaboration evident but article lacks direct CIO/digital infrastructure angle
